newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers firm, non-firm power Sat-Mon.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers firm, non-firm power Sat-Mon.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) expanded its offers for Saturday through Monday pre-schedulings to include firm as well as non-firm power, the federal agency said Friday.

BPA offered up to 500 megawatts (MW) of firm power only during light-load hours on Monday. Saturday firm offers included unlimited volumes during light-load hours and up to 300 MW during heavy load hours.
No volume limits were placed on firm power for Sunday.
BPA offered firm power during light load hours on Monday at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.

Monday non-firm power was offered at $18.50 for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST for all deliveries. Northwest power for hours ending 0600 and 2300 PST on Monday was offered at $22.00, while COB deliveries were priced at $20.00.
Firm power during light-load hours on Saturday was offered at $16.00 in both the Northwest and COB, while power during heavy load hours was offered at $20.25 in the Northwest and $21.00 at COB.
Sunday firm power during light-load hours was offered at $16.00 for all deliveries, while heavy-load volumes were offered at $19.25 in the Northwest and $20.00 at COB.
Non-firm power for both Saturday and Sunday was offered at $16.00-18.00 for all deliveries.
